about: Kingston sits at the eastern end of Lake Ontario, where the St. Lawrence River and the Rideau Canal begin. It is a historic military and university city with limestone buildings and a large penitentiary legacy. Downtown occupies a peninsula between the Cataraqui River and the lake. About 130,000 people live in Kingston.
